name: rapibase-backend-tools
description: Build, deploy, and operate Rapibase projects with four skills and a remote MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage Rapibase projects from a conversation. The skills guide database and authentication design, deployments, server functions, logs, and troubleshooting. Connect your Rapibase account with OAuth to use project tools. Actions are limited to projects and permissions you authorize.
defaultPrompt: Show my Rapibase projects and their status.
Help me design a database for my app.
Find errors in my Rapibase project logs.
